title: Float ⇄ RGBA (IEEE754)
summary: Lossless packing of a 32‑bit float into RGBA8 and back. Useful when the screen (rgba8) is your storage medium.

title: r32float Bus: Identity Node
summary: Reads r32float state and writes it back unchanged. Template for nodes that operate on an r32float screen-bus.

title: Screen Luminance Analyzer
summary: Converts an input screen to luminance (grayscale) using BT.709 weights.

title: Visual Game of Life (Toroidal)
summary: Conway’s Game of Life on the screen grid; edges wrap around (toroidal). Uses red channel > 0.5 as 'alive'.

title: N×N Convolution (Kernel from Control Strip)
summary: Reads an N×N kernel from a control strip on row 0 and applies it over the image.

title: Sobel Edge Detector
summary: Classic Sobel operator using luminance, emits edge magnitude.

title: Luminance Histogram (256 bins, atomics)
summary: Bins per-pixel luminance into 256 counters using atomics in a storage buffer.

title: Temporal EMA Accumulator
summary: Exponential moving average between current and previous frames.

title: Screen-Driven Hash Noise
summary: Deterministic hash-based noise per pixel, animated over frame index.

title: Distance Transform (Chamfer Relaxation Step)
summary: One relaxation sweep toward a chamfer distance field using 4-neighborhood approximation.

title: Row-wise Sum (Workgroup Reduction)
summary: Sums each 16-wide tile per row into one value using workgroup-shared memory; building block for scans.

title: Screen-as-Queue (Ring Buffer Protocol)
summary: Implements a tiny ring buffer where head/tail are encoded in two pixels; pushes from an inbox pixel to queue row.
